candidate.title: Ask: Reveal How LLMs See Your Website
candidate.description:
In the age of large language models, visibility depends on understanding how the machine understands you.

Ask is Market Brew’s diagnostic instrument for the LLM era — powered by the same algorithms that drive ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Mode.

It doesn’t just answer questions. It reveals how your website is represented inside the embedding space that LLMs use to reason about meaning.
Ask exposes the blind spots, measures the semantic gaps, and feeds those signals into your Visibility Launchpad, so you can act on what the AI truly sees.

Your site isn’t just searchable — it’s measurable, explainable, and self-healing.

Learn more: https://marketbrew.ai/
